wire.voice.title: Voice mode
wire.voice.description: Talk hands-free to one conversation at a time. That conversation's own agent answers, and its reply is read aloud. Read on the next spoken reply.
wire.voice.max_spoken_chars.label: longest spoken reply
wire.voice.max_spoken_chars.help: Replies longer than this many characters are cut at a sentence and end with "That's where I'll stop — the rest is on screen." Code blocks and links are never read aloud.
wire.voice.not_enabled: Voice mode is not on for this conversation. Turn it on for this conversation first.
wire.voice.unknown_session: There is no conversation with id {session_id}.
wire.voice.unknown_source: There is nothing to read aloud for that reference.
wire.voice.invalid_request: No words came with that request, so nothing was sent.
wire.voice.empty_transcript: Nothing was heard, so nothing was sent.
wire.voice.store_busy: Something else on this device is changing voice mode. Try again in a moment.
wire.voice.invalid_request_id: The request id must be a dashed UUID, so nothing was sent.
wire.voice.approval_pending: Answer the question or approval on screen first.
wire.voice.invalid_text_origin: text_origin names where the words came from: qwen_s2s, or leave it out.
